intro.title: You stop where two roads cross. Someone is already sitting there.
intro.text: “I keep nothing you tell me. Answer quickly, and I’ll show you who is waiting on your road.”

plain.title: A few questions, then three people you could be.
plain.text: Nothing here can be answered wrongly. It takes about three minutes.

dilemmas.scene: The fair folk offer you a gift for your name.
A plague ship asks to dock.
Your teacher is wrong, and everyone is watching.
A door you were told never to open stands ajar.

roster.name: Zanetta Bon
roster.scene: Venice, Carnival, an hour before dawn. A small woman in a bauta mask and a soaked cloak runs the ridge of a roof above the Rio di San Barnaba with three of the Council of Ten's men a roof behind her. The canal is forty feet down and twenty across. She doesn't slow. She steps off the edge into nothing, falls, and comes out of a door in the side of the campanile across the water still falling sideways, lands running on the next roof, and the door closes behind her like a shutter. The men stop at the edge. One of them has dropped his lantern into the canal.
roster.play: You are hard to pin down, and you get people through places they should never reach.
roster.class_note: Danae are people the Hidden has marked, and they move between worlds.

signature.name: Your trick
signature.line: You are hard to pin down, and you get people through places they should never reach.

roster.name: Tonderai Shumba
roster.line: The capital calls them Lionskins, after the lion masks the first suits wore at the king's gates; the suits are metal.
roster.scene: The Portuguese have rushed the gate twice. The third time the lion in the gateway lets the first man reach him, takes the blow meant for the boy beside him, and the copper mane stands straight up. Then the lion speaks, at three hundred feet, and the line behind the man stops.
roster.play: You stand in the gap, and nobody gets past you.
roster.class_note: A Mhizha builds wonders that work.

signature.name: Your trick
signature.line: You stand in the gap, and nobody gets past you.

roster.name: Yusuf Rais
roster.region: The Ottomans, Persia and the Horn
roster.line: Someone of The Ottomans, Persia and the Horn.
roster.scene: A galley's stern in the roads off Algiers, the city white on its hill behind. A Livorno merchant has come out under a flag of truce with a chest and a list of names. The captain doesn't open the chest. He reads the list, bites one coin, and names a price for each man on it in Spanish dollars, Venetian sequins, and Algerian sultanis, without looking up. Two of the names, he says, are worth more than the merchant thinks, and he would like to know why.
roster.play: You watch first, then spend what you learned at the worst moment for them.
roster.class_note: A Counsellor wins by knowing first.

roster.name: Akinwale
roster.line: In Euphonia the Yoruba are West Africa's great Wisdom power, and in the field that power looks like spirit riding: the orisha mount their devotees.
roster.scene: The Nupe line is set on the far bank, spears grounded, and Oyo's horsemen come down to the ford at a walk. Halfway across, one of them stops riding like a man. His back straightens, his face is somebody else's, and the horse, which knows, goes from a walk to a gallop without being asked. The men on the bank remember afterward that he was laughing. He doesn't remember any of it.
roster.play: You ride straight at the danger and make everyone behind you braver.
roster.class_note: A Paladin fights under an oath.

signature.name: Your trick
signature.line: You ride straight at the danger and make everyone behind you braver.

roster.name: Kesavan Vaidyan
roster.scene: A veranda in a Malabar compound in the monsoon light. A soldier from the war of noses sits very still, drugged and steady. The surgeon has cut a leaf to the shape of a nose and laid it on the man's forehead; now the knife hangs in the air beside the soldier's face, held by nothing, and draws the line around the leaf as slowly as a man writing his name. The surgeon's hands are folded in his lap. He is watching the patient's breathing, not the knife.
roster.play: You keep your friends alive, and you know exactly where to cut.
roster.class_note: A Physician keeps people alive, and knows how bodies fail.

signature.name: Your trick
signature.line: You keep your friends alive, and you know exactly where to cut.

roster.name: Shi Yuanjing
roster.line: Shaolin's fighting monks came badly through the fall of the Ming, and in 1668 they wait to see what the new dynasty wants with armed monasteries.
roster.scene: The bannermen came up the valley road to count the monks, and the abbot sent him down to meet them alone, with a staff and nothing else. The officer asked what the staff was for. He set its foot on the road, walked three steps up the face of the gate tower as if it were the road, and sat down on the lintel to wait for the next question.
roster.play: You move first and fast, and you need nothing but your hands and a staff.
roster.class_note: A Monk turns a trained body into a weapon.

signature.name: Your trick
signature.line: You move first and fast, and you need nothing but your hands and a staff.

roster.name: Waman Illa
roster.line: In 1621 a priest recorded that whoever survives a lightning strike "is as though divinely chosen for the ministry of the huacas." He survived one.
roster.scene: On the ridge above the Spanish column the cloud has been building all morning. He stands in the spray of it with his sling hanging loose, and the first bolt comes down on the captain's horse because he asked it to. Then the wind takes him up, and the arquebusiers below learn why the high ground holds.
roster.play: You call the weather down on whoever stands in the open.
roster.class_note: A Druid speaks for the living world and borrows its strength.

signature.name: Your trick
signature.line: You call the weather down on whoever stands in the open.

roster.name: Sehpin
roster.line: Pohnpei is the civilization druids and clerics built: two sorcerer brothers, Olisihpa and Olosohpa, raised Nan Madol's basalt by magic, and in Euphonia they did.
roster.scene: A Spanish pilot off the reef sees it from the deck: a column of black basalt, longer than his ship's mast, lifting out of the shallows and laying itself crosswise on a wall that was already old. The figure standing on the wall doesn't look up at the ship. When the pilot asks his crew what they saw, none of them will say.
roster.play: You hold your people together when everything else has given way.
roster.class_note: A Cleric carries a power that answers faith.

signature.name: Your trick
signature.line: You hold your people together when everything else has given way.

roster.name: Nurbibi
roster.line: Someone of The Steppe and the North.
roster.scene: A blind of felt on a ridge of red sandstone, the ninth day. Below, on a shelf of quartz still warm from the sun, a beast the size of a sheep with a beak and a bony frill is settling over a clutch of eggs. Her grandmother called it a griffin, an eagle-headed lion that guarded the khans' gold. It is not. It is a mother, and the quartz holds the day's heat into the night. She writes that down, in a careful hand, and the date, and then she draws its foot.
roster.play: You learn what a thing is before it learns what you are.
roster.class_note: A Natural Philosopher gets results from understanding, with no spells at all.

signature.name: Your trick
signature.line: You learn what a thing is before it learns what you are.
